reviews.comment: He is hard to understand and isn't that great of a teacher, I am very good at math and had to teach myself a lot of the material. The hw is really easy since there are multiple tries. At the end of the semester if you are like 2 points away from the next letter grade he curves ur grade up.

Professor Lin is very nice and timid, however his lectures are lengthy, boring, and difficult to follow. The grading for homework was very lenient as you had multiple tries for each question, but the tests were terrible. He grades strictly on the tests and the questions barely correlate with the reviews. I love math, but this class was so hard.

Professor Lin is such a sweet guy and really cares about your mental health and success in his class. I took math 168 thinking it would be a blowoff class, but I really had to work for an A. Dr. Lin's way of teaching is not always super clear, but if you go to his office hours or the math learning center you can get a better understanding.

Worst class I have taken. Lectures are horrible, his explanations are slow and we had to correct him a number of times . Class average's for tests were failing and he gave no curves. Gave a little extra credit in the end which was nice but other than that just not a good professor.

Professor Lin is a super nice and understanding guy and I respect him entirely. However, he does have a habit of not being able to explain processes in different ways other than what he knows. He gives good extra credit. His tests are super hard ( I passed 2/4). He is however super responsive and if you need help hes always willing to try and help
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: His lectures don't make sense and he explains things so slowly that it's impossible to pay attention so I had to teach myself all semester. He makes hw easy to get an A on since there are 3 attempts for each question until you start getting penalized. Tests don't match up with lectures/hw at all. Only passed 2 tests this semester. Frustrating.
